item.title: Jev in 25 Lines of Python
item.description: Everyone is talking about Jev - here it is in 25 lines of Python. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: I am done with this shit
Microsoft killed FoxPro in 2007. Anyway, here's FoxPro revived
item.description: A modern IDE and 64-bit runtime for Visual FoxPro 9 applications: the same language, rebuilt on Electron, React and a Rust virtual machine in WebAssembly. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Apple has added persistent 'ads' to iOS, and it's driving users crazy
There's a high chance of devices being sold with GrapheneOS preinstalled in 2027
item.description: @tranquil_cassowary@infosec.exchange @ocelot221@mastodon.social @mhoye@cosocial.ca @mulchmaxxing@blahaj.zone There's a high chance of devices being sold with it preinstalled in 2027 but probably not for the initial launch. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: 'We hacked the FBI:' Hackers say they have data on all FBI employees
item.description: A sample of 5,000 alleged agents seen by 404 Media includes names, addresses, phone numbers, and details on FBI employees' spouses. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Google Adds Cycle-Level Kernel Profiling to XProf
item.description: Google has added a Kernel Profiling suite to XProf. This is its open-source profiler for TPU workloads. Now, developers can see cycle-level details in custom Pallas kernels. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Latest BGP hijack targets hosting software vendor
item.description: Guest Post: An analysis of the BGP hijack against Softaculous that enabled an attacker to obtain a fraudulent TLS certificate and distribute a malicious Virtualizor update. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: The GitHub wiki is an anti-pattern
item.description: Using the wiki on GitHub makes life more difficult for your users, and you as a maintainer. Use the `/docs` folder and GitHub Pages instead and keep your docs in sync with code (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: SAML: A fractal of bad design
item.description: SAML, the XML-based authentication protocol that birthed the SSO industry, is fundamentally flawed due to XML complexity, canonicalization issues, enveloped signatures, and design ossification, making it vulnerable to signature wrapping… (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Abandoning Scientific Linux Was a Mistake
item.description: CERN's move to Debian for accelerator control systems is a reminder that Scientific Linux was worth more than the small team required to maintain it. (1 source: lobsters)
